Progressive Falcon Verification Gates
An agent economy resists sybils by requiring a 24-hour voyage of sequential verified actions on every new key. The agent must complete 6 tasks, each separated by a 3-hour wait and costing 0.2 units, while gathering endorsements along a vine of 4 peers. A falcon scanner flags parallel registrations sharing timing. A farm of fake accounts would need to fund 6 payments and endure 24 hours of waits per bot, totaling 1.2 units and day-long orchestration. This multiplies attacker cost through enforced serial latency.
